features.name: Realistic Public Agriculture Homepage
features.expectedBehaviour: Explains platform services before requiring login; displays value pillars, Rajasthan farmer impact stats, and clear calls-to-action in forest green, cream, and charcoal palette.
features.dataSource: Local semantic content & verified cluster data
features.testCheck: Audit: Homepage renders semantic h1, explanation precedes auth, no purple/sci-fi/AI elements.

features.name: Multi-Role Authentication & Session Management
features.expectedBehaviour: Provides 10-digit Indian Mobile OTP login (+91), email/password login, farmer/trader registration with Jamabandi land title proof, session persistence via localStorage/Supabase, and quick demo role switcher.
features.testCheck: Unit test validates 10-digit mobile check, OTP verification, role redirection, and logout.

features.name: JKLU-Anchored Interactive Map & Photographic Pins
features.expectedBehaviour: Renders Google Maps satellite/roadmap tiles centered at JKLU Jaipur (26.8378, 75.6499). Uses authentic photographic teardrop pins showing real Indian farmland, tractors, and trucks. Filterable by 5km, 10km, 25km, 50km radius.
features.dataSource: Google Maps Tile Layer + OpenStreetMap tiles fallback
features.testCheck: Verify center lat/lng matches JKLU; markers display photographic teardrop frames; zero purple/orange circle icons.

features.name: OSRM Real Road Distance & Turn-by-Turn Route Engine
features.expectedBehaviour: Calculates real driving kilometers and transit duration from JKLU anchor to farm parcels using Open Source Routing Machine (OSRM); draws polyline route on map.
features.testCheck: Route request to Mahapura returns valid geometry and updates driving banner.

features.name: Agricultural Crop & Produce Trading Marketplace
features.expectedBehaviour: Browse active wheat, mustard, and grain listings with real photos, live distance, prices in INR, and sorting by proximity to JKLU.
features.dataSource: Verified baseline listings + Supabase crop_listings table
features.testCheck: Cards list authentic photos, price in INR, and click activates details drawer.

features.name: Farm Machinery & Implement Rental Engine
features.expectedBehaviour: Enables leasing tractors, tillers, and sprayers with mathematically audited discounts: 15% off weekly leases, 25% off monthly leases.

features.name: Agro-Waste & Crop Residue Trading (Stubble Prevention)
features.expectedBehaviour: Direct marketplace for rice straw bales and wheat bhusa to prevent stubble burning, linking farmers with bio-energy and paper plants.
features.testCheck: Category filter 'agrowaste' returns straw bale listings with bale unit pricing.

features.name: Photographic Item Specifications Drawer
features.expectedBehaviour: Slides out at z-index: 3000 over map to display full-width authentic parcel/equipment photo, verified Jamabandi land title status, and lease calculator.
features.testCheck: Drawer contains high-resolution photo banner, Jamabandi verification badge, and close button.

features.name: Farmer Crop Production & Sales Dashboard
features.expectedBehaviour: Manage crop land parcels, record harvests, publish directly to live marketplace, monitor active leases, and track incoming buyer orders.
features.testCheck: Record harvest generates valid marketplace item and updates sales ledger.

features.name: Multi-Stakeholder Provider Dashboards
features.expectedBehaviour: Provides dedicated operational interfaces for Machinery Fleet Owners, Warehouse Operators, Goods Transporters, Seed Suppliers, Agricultural Extension Officers, and FPO Directors.
features.testCheck: Role navigation switches views cleanly and displays fleet, dispatches, and warehouse occupancy.

features.name: Administrative Audit & Moderation Console
features.expectedBehaviour: Security-gated moderation panel for verifying Rajasthan Jamabandi land titles, resolving buyer-farmer trade disputes, and moderating public listings.
features.testCheck: Actioning verification queue updates status to 'Verified' and writes audit log.

features.name: Formal Buyer-Farmer Quotation Negotiation
features.expectedBehaviour: Enables bulk commodity buyers to submit structured price proposals, delivery schedules, and quality requirements with clear terms.
features.testCheck: Submitting valid quotation emits confirmation and adds to farmer incoming requests.

features.name: Procurement Cart & Booking Ledger
features.expectedBehaviour: Add produce lots or machinery leases to cart, calculate subtotal and delivery charges, enforce minimum order quantities, and proceed to booking.
features.testCheck: Item addition updates cart count badge and recalculates grand total.

features.name: Live Order Status & Dispatch Tracker
features.expectedBehaviour: Enter booking reference (e.g. ORD-7821) to check settlement, transporter dispatch status, and pickup coordination details.
features.testCheck: Valid reference code displays order summary; unknown code provides honest offline check guidance.

features.name: NPCI Dynamic UPI & Direct Bank Settlement Gateway
features.expectedBehaviour: Generates verified UPI QR string (`upi://pay?...`) with exact INR amount; validates 12-digit bank UTR numbers; strictly never fakes payment success.
features.dataSource: NPCI UPI specification & Cashfree sandbox fallback
features.testCheck: Create order returns valid UPI URI; verify rejects non-12-digit UTR and accepts valid 12-digit transaction ID.

features.name: IMD Weather & Jaipur Met Centre Agrometeorological Advisory
features.expectedBehaviour: Displays real temperature, humidity, rainfall forecast, and official Rajasthan Krishi Vigyan Kendra crop advisories.
features.testCheck: fetchImdWeather returns temperature and advisory notes.

features.name: Agmarknet Daily Rajasthan Mandi Rates
features.expectedBehaviour: Daily wholesale commodity modal prices for Jaipur Muhana Mandi, Kukar Kheda, and Alwar with honest fallback when government API key is unconfigured.
features.testCheck: fetchMandiRates returns verified commodity prices or transparent unconfigured warning.

features.name: Supabase PostgreSQL Database & Row-Level Security
features.expectedBehaviour: PostgreSQL relational schema with tables: profiles, crop_listings, machinery_rentals, orders, quotes, audit_logs. Strict RLS ensures coordinates are public only with seller consent.
features.testCheck: Migration SQL checks out; client initializes without throwing.

features.name: Bilingual Hindi / English Agricultural Localization
features.expectedBehaviour: Toggles entire interface between authentic Rajasthani rural Hindi terminology (फसल मंडी, कृषि यंत्र, पराली प्रबंधन) and clear English.
features.testCheck: Toggle switches active language and updates UI labels.
